The reality is that even if the Bitcoin Bear Market Bottom was in already...

Then any deeper pullback into a new Macro Higher Low would confirm that

Which would allow to build entries at prices not much higher than the absolute bottom

And if you build entries there, those entries will outperform 95-99% of investors over the course of the entire Bitcoin cycle

More, the Macro Higher Low would offer slight premium prices compared to the absolute bottom but at least that premium is the cost of buying on confirmation

You don't need to buy the absolute Bitcoin Bear Market Bottom to do well in a Bull Cycle

The way I think about my analysis, is it's not focused on traders although they can certainly use it for that. Instead, the idea is that most of us have Bitcoin as a core part of our life savings. It's also volatile, which means our life savings is volatile.

My analysis is aimed at helping HODLers better understand and visualise WHY Bitcoin moves the way it does. This calms the nerves and educates along the way.

Same reason athletes still have personal trainers, you always benefit from someone who is a professional adding fresh perspective. You also needle to keep going to the gym to maintain results.

颇感意外

我第一次见许老板是在 2017 年，当时是在北京一个孵化器的讲座上。

他是第 2 个嘉宾，我是第 3 个。

他的口才这一块，令我记到今天。

他先说卖关子说，他在给以太坊网络做贡献，正当别人都疑惑时，他才说是以太坊的 PoW 矿工，安全贡献也是贡献（而且还赚钱），听众才恍然大悟。

时至今日，我变成了一个以太坊 PoS 矿工，但我仍然在拾许老板十年前之牙慧，常说我们在给以太坊网络做贡献。

以前，总是劝别人，人到中登年纪——就得加强锻炼。

但是前逢张老师之憾事，后遇许老板之罹患，我也不敢轻易再劝，只望大家都平安、健康。
